dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible across the mid-lateral field. The most prominent structures show a sharp gradient transition from a dark exterior background to a high-intensity, light-colored perimeter (approximately 3-10 pixels wide) which encloses a lower-intensity dark center. These annuli vary in diameter, with some exhibiting non-uniform, jagged edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a high spatial density of high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated along the central longitudinal axis. These clusters often appear as solid, localized bright spots without internal gradients, frequently positioned between or adjacent to the larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A distinct cluster of three macro-annuli in the upper-mid region forms an elongated scalene triangle. Along the lower lateral edge, a series of smaller high-intensity blobs form a linear chain with consistent relative spacing, while a grouping of four larger annuli in the anterior region forms an irregular trapezoidal polygon.
